The code snippet provided does not directly indicate any errors, so we may need to look into the implementation of the `StringEncoder` or related classes to understand the issue better.

The recent bug reports retrieved do not seem directly related to the current issue, so we will focus on understanding the behavior in the `StringEncoder` class to diagnose the problem further.
